title: Decisions
purpose: The design-decisions of this bounded context: entered with a tier, superseded by a later one, indexed, and held by the check to their tier's enforcement.

specifies: service specification: check, consult, renew, inventory, translate
title: Checking
purpose: This specification checked as a whole: its rules, the catalogue of the rules, the file forms it keeps and the facts the checks read.

title: Reading
purpose: A line read in grammar 4: parsed to one meaning or refused with why, its logical form given, the caches its parse keeps, and the terms of a pack looked up.

specifies: service specification: examine; service language: explain
title: Consistency
purpose: The requirements examined together: contradictions, what a line adds over the others, and what a requirement also means.

title: Records
purpose: Reports and research kept beside the specification, filed with a title, a summary and what they are about; nothing of the system cites one.

title: Scenarios
purpose: The scenarios generated from the requirements of a capability, each group's, with the counter-examples and boundaries that let them fail, and their steps audited for a handler.

specifies: object item, service backlog, the readiness policy
title: Items
purpose: The backlog's items through their lifecycle: noted as ideas, shaped, rated, linked, readied against the readiness bar, declined, withdrawn, answered and listed.

title: Drafting
purpose: An item's lines drafted: requirement lines, relation rows, given blocks, universal conditions, upstream entries, new capabilities, retirements, rewordings and chores.

specifies: object context request, service context requests
title: Context requests
purpose: The requests between bounded contexts: raised by an asker, answered by its upstream turn by turn, settled line by line, accepted into an item and resolved once delivered.

title: Request watch
purpose: What a session is told of the context requests waiting on this bounded context: at its start, while it watches, and as it catches up.

specifies: object quote, service conversation: quote, prompt, read
title: Quotes
purpose: The person's words quoted from a session's transcript, with the messages they cite.

specifies: object directive, service conversation: give, promote, drop
title: Directives
purpose: The person's short-term directions: given with their quote, told to every session while live, promoted or dropped.

specifies: object batch, object task, service batches
title: Batches
purpose: Batches of ready items: opened, their tasks finished in workspaces of their own, items parked, abandoned or delivered when the change is merged.

specifies: object review, object proposed change, service batches: submit
title: Reviews
purpose: A batch's change submitted for review once its tasks are done, holding only the kept changes of the items still in it.

narrator: the session that started a review
title: Review guarantees
purpose: What `pr-reviewer` reads and writes in reviewing a batch's change, and where its findings send the batch.

title: Measurement
purpose: What a batch cost and what it found: measured once merged, compared with another, and defects reported against its items.

narrator: the session that started a trial
title: Trials
purpose: One trial conducted by `trial-runner` on its target, changing nothing but the measurement it keeps.

title: Toolchain
purpose: The analysis tools and the Python interpreter they run with: probed and installed.

title: Code analysis
purpose: This repository's code read: test coverage mapped and traced, untested functions screened, references located, files linted and sized.

title: Feature reading
purpose: The Gherkin of feature files read: scenarios searched, counted by tag, deprecated ones scanned and bindings vetted.

title: Upgrades
purpose: A repository moved between plugin releases: its release queried, its upgrade steps applied, a bounded context relocated to the final layout.

specifies: guarantees of shaping with the person
title: Shaping guarantees
purpose: What the brainstorming session does as it shapes items with the person: it drafts and readies lines and asks nothing back.
